name: LRS2: Lip Reading Sentences 2 Benchmark
description: LRS2 (Lip Reading Sentences 2) is a benchmark dataset for visual and audiovisual speech recognition consisting of 144,482 video utterance clips (over 224 hours of video) extracted from British television broadcasts on BBC television.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group, University of Oxford & BBC R&D

license.name: Custom Non-Commercial BBC Agreement
license.notes: Distributed exclusively for non-commercial research upon signing the BBC and University of Oxford Data Agreement.

verification.notes: Verified against IEEE TPAMI paper (DOI: 10.1109/TPAMI.2018.2889052) and VGG release. Total clips: 144,482 (pretrain: 96,318, train: 45,839, validation: 1,082, test: 1,243) totaling 224.5 hours of video.

size.notes: MPEG-4 video clips and word-level text transcription files.
